data.name: Faouzi
data.gender_notes: Faouzi is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The one who is intelligent, wise, rich, and a protector. Derived from the Arabic word 'fa'a', meaning 'to possess' and 'zay', meaning 'intelligence' or 'wisdom'. The name Faouzi carries the meaning “Intelligent, Wise, Rich” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Faouzi usually hope their child will grow to embody intelligent, wise, rich and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Faouzi represents the inner wisdom and intelligence of an individual, as well as their ability to protect and provide for themselves and their loved ones.
data.etymology: Faouzi belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Intelligent, Wise, Rich.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Faouzi total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
